_comment: Migration step for the plugin protocol jump P7 -> P8. Consumed by `mads plugin --update`. P8 does NOT change the plugin child-class method signatures (kind/load_data/process/get_output/set_params/info are identical to P7); it replaces the per-type registration macros with a single type-deducing macro. See src/main/plugin_migrate.hpp for the transform semantics.

source.description: Replace INSTALL_FILTER_DRIVER(klass, type_in, type_out) with MADS_REGISTER_PLUGINS(klass)

notes: Registration changed: INSTALL_SOURCE/FILTER/SINK_DRIVER are now deprecated aliases; the new MADS_REGISTER_PLUGINS(klass) macro deduces the input/output types from the class and can register several plugins from one library, e.g. MADS_REGISTER_PLUGINS(MySrc, MySink).
Plugin child-class method signatures are unchanged from P7 (kind/load_data/process/get_output/set_params/info), so no method bodies need editing.
The generated driver's create() now returns std::unique_ptr and register_pugg_plugin returns bool, but both live inside the macro; hand-written custom drivers must be updated to match.
pugg is bumped to 1.2.0 alongside mads_plugin v2.4-P8.
